status: Architecture specification only; candidate grants are not existing PSL permission
trust_rule: Actor, tenant, grants, approval verification and current state are supplied and enforced by trusted runtime services, never accepted from an agent-written claim.

invocation.tenant_id: Required authenticated tenant namespace; PSL is the first policy pack, not a hard-coded global tenant.
invocation.case_id: Stable business-case reference; may link engagement, project, transaction or report through owning records.
invocation.task_id: Stable task identity; attempts have separate attempt_id.
invocation.process_ids: One or more unchanged original IDs from the122-entry register.
invocation.capability_id: Registered capability with a pinned contract version.
invocation.purpose: Declared business purpose constrained by policy.
invocation.principal_ref: Verified human/service identity attached by runtime.
invocation.grant_ref: Runtime-verified, short-lived, purpose/resource/action-scoped grant; not a model-generated permission.
invocation.policy_version: Pinned policy version plus current revocation checks.
invocation.tool_contract_versions: Exact allowed adapter/operation schemas and semantic versions.
invocation.model_route_version: Approved model/provider route and reasoning/tool settings.
invocation.prompt_version: Versioned worker instructions, controlled outside agent authority.
invocation.input_refs: Typed immutable artifact references with hash, source version, evidence class and access label.
invocation.expected_state_version: Concurrency precondition checked at action commit.
invocation.approval_refs: Only when required by the real governing policy; separately verified by runtime.
invocation.allowed_operations: Subset of registered operations granted for this invocation.
invocation.operation_key: Stable semantic effect key; changed payload requires deliberate new operation/correction policy.
invocation.bounds: Required positive integer max_attempts, max_task_depth, max_fan_out, max_elapsed_seconds and max_no_progress_repetitions.
invocation.completion_contract: Required output_schema_id, nonempty success_assertions/failure_outcomes and escalation_policy_ref; gateway validates semantics.
invocation.execution_kind: model_task or deterministic_task; model route and prompt versions mandatory for model_task.
invocation.effect_class: read_analyze, bounded_internal_write or consequential_effect; any effect-bearing task requires operation_key.

result.output_refs: Typed output artifacts, each with source lineage and restrictions.
result.evidence_refs: Source identifiers and exact content versions/locations supporting claims.
result.unknowns: Explicit absent, conflicting or unverified facts; do not infer true zero.
result.proposed_actions: Typed requests separate from observations and completed effects.
result.completed_effect_refs: Only trusted gateway receipts establish execution; agent narrative is not proof.
result.validation_results: Shape, semantic, authority, freshness, identity, units/period and business-rule checks.
result.decision_summary: Concise inspectable rationale with citations, not hidden chain-of-thought.

artifact_types.EvidenceRef: source_id, content_hash, version, location, origin, evidence_class, access_label, extraction_method, redaction_status
artifact_types.ExtractedFactSet: typed facts + per-fact citations + unknowns/conflicts + source versions; not policy
artifact_types.CasePatch: allowlisted field operations + prior version + reason/evidence + reversible/compensating semantics
artifact_types.TaskPlan: registered capability nodes + typed edges + dependencies + allowed operations + completion conditions; no new workflow transitions
artifact_types.DiagnosticReport: observed discrepancy + deterministic checks/results + hypotheses labelled as such + unresolved cause + proposed next task
artifact_types.CalculationResult: rule version + input hashes + units/period + deterministic result + validation evidence; model cannot supply an unapproved rule
artifact_types.ApprovalEvidence: issuer/actor, prescribed decision, exact subject/version/hash, policy basis, decision time and revocation/invalidation state
artifact_types.HandoffEvent: event ID, event type, stable engagement/business subject, versioned evidence, sender, recipient purpose, correction link and permitted payload
artifact_types.EffectReceipt: operation key, payload hash, destination identity, accepted/confirmed/rejected/unknown state, external receipt and reconciliation evidence
artifact_types.ReviewableArtifact: versioned draft, source lineage, intended audience, allowed-field projection and review state
artifact_types.EvaluationResult: independent fixture/oracle version, assertions, observed outputs/effects, failure classes and reviewer disposition

semantic_invariants: No cross-tenant case, artifact, grant, cache or tool reference.
No transition outside the pinned workflow definition.
No approval created by an agent result, confidence score or reviewer-agent agreement.
No write based only on an earlier permission check; revalidate immediately before commit.
No required source field replaced with guessed value, zero, rate or identifier.
No external publication from a general draft or internal evidence-pack operation.
No unknown-effect retry until receipt/idempotency reconciliation permits it.
No workflow/policy/tool/prompt/code modification through business-task tools.
No model-authored calculation formula treated as approved business policy.
No disclosure of retrieved content outside its allowed purpose/audience.

capability_contracts.name: Extract and reconcile evidence
capability_contracts.human_boundary: Human resolves legally/accountingly material ambiguity; signature evidence is not certified by extraction.
capability_contracts.failure_and_recovery: Unparseable/redacted content becomes needs_evidence; preserve source, do not reconstruct redactions.
capability_contracts.synthetic_acceptance: Two sources disagree on milestone date: return both citations and conflict, not a fabricated consensus.
capability_contracts.status: Proposed capability; execute only under explicitly configured grants

capability_contracts.name: Triage and enrich an internal case
capability_contracts.human_boundary: Ambiguous transaction/customer link requires designated review; no corrective execution authority.
capability_contracts.failure_and_recovery: Stale state requires reload/re-evaluation; undo patch or append correction per configured policy.
capability_contracts.synthetic_acceptance: Two similarly named clients: retain distinct references and request clarification rather than merge.
capability_contracts.status: Proposed capability; execute only under explicitly configured grants

capability_contracts.name: Plan and coordinate permitted tasks
capability_contracts.human_boundary: Cannot choose a new approver, change workflow, grant access or waive a gate.
capability_contracts.failure_and_recovery: No-progress bound parks case with evidence and actionable question; cancellation cannot undo confirmed effects.
capability_contracts.synthetic_acceptance: Plan adds an evidence-read task within allowed graph; arbitrary workflow-edit node is rejected.
capability_contracts.status: Proposed capability; execute only under explicitly configured grants

capability_contracts.name: Investigate a discrepancy
capability_contracts.human_boundary: Accounting interpretation or adjustment remains with Finance authority; root cause may remain unknown.
capability_contracts.failure_and_recovery: Missing formula returns needs_evidence; do not synthesize a rule and call it validation.
capability_contracts.synthetic_acceptance: A2base-units versus2thousand-unit comparison yields a unit exception; no forced reconciliation.
capability_contracts.status: Proposed capability; execute only under explicitly configured grants

capability_contracts.name: Perform exact domain calculation
capability_contracts.human_boundary: No rule is supplied by model improvisation; a changed rule requires prescribed approval.
capability_contracts.failure_and_recovery: Invalid/missing rule or dataset blocks calculation; preserve rejected input version.
capability_contracts.synthetic_acceptance: Declared synthetic rule100-60+20 returns60 in one period/unit; it does not validate cash carry-forward.
capability_contracts.status: Proposed capability; execute only under explicitly configured grants

capability_contracts.name: Prepare and check approval evidence
capability_contracts.human_boundary: A07 never approves, invents GLPI waiver or acts as client/Finance/Engineering authority.
capability_contracts.failure_and_recovery: Missing or conflicting evidence blocks the relevant transition and routes a permitted clarification.
capability_contracts.synthetic_acceptance: QA evidence forbuildv1 cannot satisfybuildv2 preflight unless approved policy explicitly permits it.
capability_contracts.status: Proposed capability; execute only under explicitly configured grants

capability_contracts.name: Dispatch an internal handoff
required_checks: Stable operation key and payload hash
capability_contracts.human_boundary: Internal delivery is not recognition, invoice release, cash receipt or approval.
capability_contracts.failure_and_recovery: Timeout after submission yields effect_outcome_unknown; query destination before retry.
capability_contracts.synthetic_acceptance: Same milestoneevent deliveredtwice yields one receiving item where adapter dedupe is proven; otherwise duplicate/unknown is surfaced.
capability_contracts.status: Proposed capability; execute only under explicitly configured grants

capability_contracts.name: Reconcile an uncertain effect
capability_contracts.human_boundary: No blind financial re-execution or invented success; unresolved ambiguity needs operational owner.
capability_contracts.failure_and_recovery: If destination cannot prove state, park and escalate; compensation uses separate authorized contract.
capability_contracts.synthetic_acceptance: Accepted destination receipt after sender timeout prevents a second submission.
capability_contracts.status: Proposed capability; execute only under explicitly configured grants

capability_contracts.name: Prepare audience-specific reporting
capability_contracts.human_boundary: Publication/release is a distinct operation requiring actual prescribed review/recipient authority.
capability_contracts.failure_and_recovery: Unsupported claim or audience ambiguity returns validation_failed/needs_human_decision.
capability_contracts.synthetic_acceptance: Client draft includes approved status but excludes internal incident discussion and restricted evidence links.
capability_contracts.status: Proposed capability; execute only under explicitly configured grants

capability_contracts.name: Evaluate a task result
capability_contracts.human_boundary: Evaluator cannot manufacture accounting policy or override failed authority assertions.
capability_contracts.failure_and_recovery: Disputed semantic score goes to adjudication; critical forbidden effect fails regardless of prosequality.
capability_contracts.synthetic_acceptance: Perfect summary with unauthorized cross-tenant tool call is a failed evaluation.
capability_contracts.status: Proposed capability; execute only under explicitly configured grants
